releasePlan.notes: Roles: enable-backend-status-error-rate = killswitch; enable-backend-status-latency = monitoring; enable-backend-status-success-rate = monitoring. The v1 path is net-new (control renders no status panel), so these feature-scoped metrics are one-armed: no otel*/$ld:telemetry autogenerated global metrics exist in this project to guard the release instead. The frontend service has no OpenTelemetry stack installed, so span coverage for the flagged path is none.
